lines.text: 一切都会发生。一切皆有可能。时间和空间并不存在。在那单薄的现实骨架上，想象飞速旋转，织出全新的图案。
lines.en: Everything can happen. Everything is possible and probable. Time and space do not exist. On a flimsy framework of reality, the imagination spins, weaving new patterns.
